title: The Harvey's Casino Bombing of 1980
summary: Hosts Josh and Chuck cover the August 1980 bombing at Harvey's Resort Hotel and Casino in Lake Tahoe, Nevada. A bomb was delivered in an IBM-labeled office machine with a ransom note demanding three million dollars. The FBI could not defuse it, the hotel and nearby buildings were evacuated, and a failed ransom drop using Harvey Gross's helicopter followed. A charge set off the bomb about 35 hours after discovery, causing major damage. The episode covers the mastermind John Waldo Burgess Sr., his sons, the accomplices, how the FBI caught them through tips and a license plate, their convictions, and Burgess's posthumous claim that a loan shark and casino executives were behind it, which the hosts dismiss. The episode ends with listener mail about parenting and discipline.

entities.name: Federal Bureau of Investigation bomb squad

segments.title: Opening banter and episode setup
segments.summary: Josh and Chuck introduce the episode as a caper, a listener request from Nick Hales, and tease the 1980 Harvey's story.

segments.title: Bomb delivery and ransom note
segments.summary: Two delivery men drop off an office machine at Harvey's at 5 am on August 8, 1980. A note reveals it is a bomb with a sensitive mechanism and demands a three million dollar ransom, along with a complicated payment plan and a demand for media silence.

segments.title: FBI response and evacuation
segments.summary: The FBI examines the bomb, finds about a thousand pounds of dynamite, and evacuates Harvey's and nearby hotels. Media and gawkers swarm the area.

segments.title: Harvey Gross and casino history
segments.summary: Background on Harvey Gross, who started with a small Wagon Wheel cabin casino at Stateline and grew it to the eleven-story Harvey's. The hosts discuss his past run-ins with tax authorities and the 1970s wave of heists in Tahoe.

segments.title: Fake ransom drop by helicopter
segments.summary: The FBI stages a fake payoff using Harvey's own helicopter and a federal agent with a suitcase. The instructions taped under a payphone send the pilot on a fruitless flight, and the drop fails.

segments.title: Detonation attempt and explosion
segments.summary: The bandits' drop goes wrong, and the bomb squad considers a shaped charge to sever the relay. A volunteer sets the charge, but the detonation sets off the full bomb, leaving a large hole and about 18 million dollars in damage.

segments.title: John Burgess Sr. and motive
segments.summary: The hosts profile mastermind John Burgess Sr., his abusive behavior, Nazi past, gambling debts, and the New Year's Eve humiliation at Harvey's that motivated the target choice.

segments.title: Investigation, arrests, and convictions
segments.summary: Tips from a hotel night manager's license plate record and an ex-girlfriend lead the FBI to the Burgess family. Sons turn on their father, the accomplices are arrested, and Burgess is convicted and dies in prison. Burgess later claims a loan shark and casino executives were behind it; the hosts doubt this.

segments.title: Listener mail on discipline and PBIS
segments.summary: A listener who teaches third grade writes about using positive behavior and supports to manage children without discipline. Chuck and Josh respond.
